title: Ned Calls Out
note: b412 — wordless Phase 1 book (non-fiction: a duckling's contact call really is how family finds it in long grass).

pages.brief: Ned the duckling waddling behind Moss the hedgehog and Olive the owl through tall green grass, a little way behind them.
Ned the duckling surrounded by tall green grass stems, looking around, his friends no longer in sight.
Ned the duckling standing with his head up and beak wide open, calling loudly, sound shown as pale rippling lines in the air.
Olive the owl turning her head sharply in flight, listening intently towards a sound coming from the grass.
Olive the owl flying low and fast back over tall grass towards where a calling sound came from.
Olive the owl landing beside Ned the duckling in the grass as Moss the hedgehog arrives too, Ned looking relieved.
